instruction: How much did I spend on amazon in this calendar year?
notes: Read-only information-gathering task: no database changes are allowed, so all amazon actions are lookups. The placeholder order object orders-this-year stands for every order placed in the current calendar year (2023); at runtime the agent pages through amazon.show_orders, filters by order_date year, calls amazon.show_order for each matching order and sums the totals into amount-total-spent-this-year, which is passed as the answer to supervisor.complete_task. The current year is given as a static init fact (current datetime 2023-05-18) so no date API is needed, matching the single-app reference solution.
